About: A family-run offbeat homestay in Fagu, Himachal Pradesh, near Kufri on the Shimla ridge. Seven warm rooms with mountain views, apple orchards, pine forests, and a private-villa calm. Heritage rooms, warm hospitality, and a view of the Kinnaur Kailash range.
